test_title: PYST 21: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Makeshift
solution: The correct answer is: **Provisional**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Makeshift **means temporary or improvised. (अस्थायी या कामचलाऊ) • **Example**: *We set up a makeshift shelter using blankets and sticks.* • Marked option **Provisional **is a synonym of makeshift and also means temporary or tentative. (अस्थायी) • **Example**: *The team worked in a provisional office until the permanent space was ready.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Resourceful **means having the ability to find solutions to problems. (समस्याओं का समाधान खोजने की क्षमता होना) • **Perpetual **means never-ending or constant. (कभी न ख़त्म होने वाला या स्थिर) • **Inconsiderate **means thoughtless or lacking in concern for others. (विचारहीन या दूसरों के प्रति चिंता का अभाव) 2f:Td72, The correct answer is: **Aspires**.
